label: Page-1 result box: 1 There is no presumption of abuse / 2 There is a presumption of abuse (check as directed in lines 40 or 42)
why: The form's outcome; every 122A-2 must check one. Not in the schema.

label: Line 40: 39d < $10,275 (export '1') / 39d > $17,150 (export '2') / between - go to line 41 (export 'On')
why: Required presumption test; not in the schema. The third option exports 'On', not '3'.

label: Monthly disposable income (39c, two widgets) and x 60 total (39d, two widgets)
why: These figures drive line 40; not in the schema (MeansTest.disposable_income exists but is never written).

label: Total deductions (line 38 total + copy) and line 39b 'Copy line 38' - one field, three widgets
why: Required total. The total-deductions figure is instead written into Quest1 (line 1) and Quest10 (line 10).

label: Adjusted current monthly income (line 4; also fills line 39a on p8)
why: Starting figure of Part 3; not in the schema.

label: 41a total nonpriority unsecured debt; 41b 25% of it (two widgets); 42 '39d < 41b' (export 'No') / '39d >= 41b' (export 'Yes')
why: Required when line 40 = 'On' (middle band). The existing rule total_nonpriority_unsecured could feed undefined_110; none of these are in the schema.

label: The number of people used in determining your deductions from income
why: Drives every IRS standard on lines 6-9; receives a dollar figure (priority debt payments) instead of a head count.

label: Subtotals: IRS expense allowances (24), additional expense deductions (32), deductions for debt payment (37)
why: Required subtotals feeding line 38 (copied into undefined_101/102/103); not in the schema.

label: Out-of-pocket health care allowance per person, count under 65, subtotal, total (7d-7f for 65 or older)
why: IRS National Standard deduction; the schema has constants with null values.

label: Number of vehicles claimed: 0 / 1 / 2 or more (export 'On')
why: Gates lines 12-15; not in the schema.

pdf_field: Quest13A / Quest13B Creditor for vehicle 1-1 / Quest13B amount for vehicle 1-1 / Quest13C
label: Vehicle 1 IRS ownership standard, secured creditor and 60-month average payment, net ownership expense
why: The car payment's correct home (and the 33b repeat); unbound while the payment is written into 13d/14/15.

label: Taxes; involuntary payroll deductions; court-ordered payments (e.g. child support paid); childcare
why: Common, often large Other Necessary Expenses; the schema has constants with null values even though ExpenseInfo.childcare and child_support_paid exist.

label: Line 2 Column B filled? / spouse filing? ; line 3 marital adjustment Yes/No (CheckBox5 Yes exports 'On') and its total Quest3 (two widgets)
why: Required Part 1 answers; not in the schema; they depend on marital status, which is not collected (DIG-53).

pdf_field: Quest9B creditor name1/amount1 ... + undefined_80 + CheckBox11 / CheckBox12 / CheckBox13
label: Home-secured debt payments (9b, repeat 33a), 33e total, and the Yes/No answers for lines 34 (cure), 35 (past-due priority), 36 (Chapter 13 eligible)
why: Deductions for debt payment and required Yes/No answers; nothing is bound. Secured debts are saved as unsecured (DIG-26), so no secured-payment data exists to bind here.

label: Special circumstances? No - go to Part 5 / Yes
why: Required Part 4 answer; not in the schema.
